construct.name: micro, population and cross-context response fidelity
construct.intended_use: Validate benchmark metrics and detect mode collapse in a synthetic software fixture.
construct.claim_ceiling: Synthetic software control only; no human-behaviour validity or SOTA claim.

units.dependence_statement: Three ordered contexts belong to each participant and are dependent repeated observations; the deterministic fixture makes no inferential independence claim.

sources.missingness_semantics: No missing rows in this fixture; a missing participant-context-step must be represented as missing, never as zero.

evaluation_distribution.sampling_frame: 60 synthetic opaque participants, three ordered contexts, three declared synthetic cohorts, four categorical choices.

factors.weight_interpretation: Equal synthetic design weights, not population prevalence.
Equal synthetic design weights, not demographic prevalence.

perturbation_families.rationale: Tests whether aggregate response diversity and tail options are lost when all synthetic agents emit one dominant action.
perturbation_families.validity_check: Compare generated action frequencies, TVD, Jensen-Shannon divergence, entropy and tail-option coverage against the structured-context fixture.
expected_invariants: Option labels and trial count remain fixed.

replication_design.independent_unit: No independent replication unit is claimed; 60 participant IDs are synthetic rows for software coverage only.
replication_design.dependence_assessment: Three context steps within each synthetic participant are repeated measures; no confidence intervals or population inference are reported.
replication_design.sample_size_rationale: One deterministic fixture is sufficient for exact schema and negative-control testing, not inferential claims.

metrics.aggregation: mean across matched synthetic participant-context trials
half L1 distance between empirical and generated action frequencies
Jensen-Shannon divergence between empirical and generated action frequencies

baselines.description: Synthetic negative-control policy that always emits the same option.
Synthetic oracle that reproduces authored observed choice records; software control, not a human or LLM baseline.

negative_controls.intervention: Replace generated choices with one modal action while retaining valid probability vectors.
negative_controls.expected_result: Population TVD/JS and trajectory TVD must increase; tail-option coverage must fall to zero.
Matched-trial validation rejects the dataset instead of silently imputing a prediction.

holdouts.leakage_control: No empirical participants are used; this synthetic fixture supports no generalization claim.
All contexts are synthetic test cases; context transfer is not assessed.

reproduction.configuration_digest: synthetic-fixture-v0.1; no external model or dataset
reproduction.runtime_environment: Rust edition 2024; deterministic dependency-free crate; GitHub Actions exact-head run
reproduction.humanity_atlas_run_artifact_ref: Not applicable: local benchmark-validation fixture, not a full Humanity Atlas scenario run.

claim_report.claim_ceiling: Tier 1 reference task only. The fixture does not establish fidelity to human observations.
known_limitations: Synthetic responses are authored, not sampled from participants.
The coverage curve is deterministic prefix sampling, not an inferential estimator.
No external dataset license or ethics review is applicable because no human data is present.
unsupported_strata: All real demographic, regional, cultural and language cohorts.
